# write_zarr { #spikepack.write_zarr }

```python
write_zarr(
    path,
    *,
    times_seconds,
    labels=None,
    quantization_us=DEFAULT_QUANTIZATION_US,
    group=None,
    chunk_size=None,
    extra_meta=None,
)
```

Write a spike train to a Zarr group.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type       | Description                                                                     | Default                   |
|-----------------|------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|
| path            | Path       | Zarr store path (a single store may hold multiple trains as sibling groups).    | _required_                |
| times_seconds   | np.ndarray | Sorted event times in seconds.                                                  | _required_                |
| labels          | np.ndarray | Per-event integer label (e.g. unit/cluster id), same length as `times_seconds`. | `None`                    |
| quantization_us | int        | Tick size in microseconds.                                                      | `DEFAULT_QUANTIZATION_US` |
| group           | str        | Subgroup name within the store (default: store root).                           | `None`                    |
| chunk_size      | int        | Chunk length in events (default: whole array in one chunk).                     | `None`                    |
| extra_meta      | dict       | Extra fields merged into the group's Zarr attributes.                           | `None`                    |
